trajectory_accounting.accounting_rule: Only the 240 B7 trajectories are new; the 720 B0/B2/B3 records are reused from the 3,200-trajectory balanced primary experiment.

interpretation_boundary: This hypothesis-driven ablation was specified after inspection of the original primary results but before any B7 response. It strengthens RQ1 mechanism decomposition and is reported as a post-primary addendum.
